test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"late."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Late"** means near the end of a period of time. (एक समयावधि के अंत के निकट; परवर्ती) • **Example**: *I met her in the **late**__ evening.* • This is the correct option to fill in the blank. • The correct answer is Option 2. • **Correct passage**: The figure of Arthur first appeared in Welsh poetry in the __**late**__ sixth and early seventh centuries, a hero who was ______ (2) ______ lead the Britons in battle against Saxon invaders. But it wasn’t ______ (3) ______ the 12th century that he was first tied to this dramatic headland, known as Tintagel. The timeless popularity of the Arthur legend has overshadowed a central, unresolved ______ (4) ______: Was there really a King Arthur, or at least a historical prototype upon whom Geoffrey's hero is ______ (5) ______? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: "Least"** is an adjective used to describe the smallest or lowest amount or degree of something. ((शब्‍द 'little' का उत्तमावस्‍था रूप) मात्रा, डिग्री आदि में सबसे कम; अल्‍पतम, न्‍यूनतम) • **Option 3: "Latest"** is an adjective used to describe the most recent or newest thing. (नवीनतम या आधुनिकतम) • **Option 4: "Latter"** is an adjective used to refer to the second of two things mentioned. (एक समयावधि के अंत के निकटतर; पिछला, परवर्ती) 1fd:Td50, The correct answer is **"said to."**
